column3: Ayase Route ・ Carnage Arc
Listen well, Kirino.
I LIKE YOUUUU!!
...Huh?
EHHHHHH?!
EHHHHHH?!
Wait, you...! That's completely different from what you were saying earlier!
Shut up! I hate you, but I also like you. I don't really get it myself, my bad!
I was so happy when we finally started talking again after all this time that I just couldn't help it.
That you came to me for advice... It made me happy. When you stopped talking to me, I felt so lonely. So lonely I thought I might die.
Uwah...
That's why I like you! Enough so that I can't live without you!
Whatever happens, I don't want to let some guy have you! If I have to, I'll just marry you!
Ah... Uu...
However...
I like Ayase just as much!
*gasp*
I like her with every fiber of my body! Actually, you could even say I love her!
So no matter what you say, I won't break up with her.
You... Do you know what ridiculous things you're saying?
Yeah. But these are my feelings. It might sound ridiculous, but it's true.
...I see. Do whatever you want then!
If you're going that far... I have nothing more to say.
Kirino...
Ayase, you like this guy, right?
Yes. I love him.
I love him as much as I love you.
Clearly...
That's the best declaration of love you can ever get from Ayase.
That's... troublesome.
Anyway, fine.
I won't bother you anymore. You two are dating while I'm still your sister and Ayase's best friend.
...Kirino, thank you.
Just let me confirm something.
If I hadn't been your sister...
What would you have done?
This seems like an important question.
In that case, I'll answer her straight from my heart.
I would've done the same.
Okay... Yeah, that's fine.
The smile that floated across Kirino's face was like a refreshing breath of wind.
